#!/bin/sh

###########################################################################
## this script define the behavior of reset button
## one click:                  reboot system (OPID is not 0000)
## double click:               deep factory default reset
## press hold more than 10s:   factory default reset
###########################################################################

. /lib/functions/leds.sh
. /lib/functions.sh
. /usr/exe/varset.sh

PRESS_HOLD_TIME=10
RESET_FILE=/configs/fresetOriginator.txt

CUR_HOLD_TIME=/tmp/btn_cur_hold_time
LAST_HOLD_TIME=/tmp/btn_last_hold_time

# INTERVAL TIME means last release to next press
INTERVAL_TIME=/tmp/btn_interval_time
BTN_ACTION=/tmp/btn_action

opid=$(ritool get OperatorID | awk '{print $2}')

led_ctrl()
{
    press_time=`date +%s`
    while [ true ]
    do
    {
        cur_time=`date +%s`
        case "$(cat $BTN_ACTION)" in
            "pressed")
                hold_time=`expr $cur_time - $press_time`
                if [ $hold_time -ge $PRESS_HOLD_TIME ];then
                    ledtool allon
                    sleep 3
                    led_hold_time=`expr $PRESS_HOLD_TIME + 1`
                    export ACTION="released"
                    export SEEN="$led_hold_time"
                    /etc/rc.button/reset
                    exit 0
                else
                    ledtool allblink
                fi
            ;;
            "released")
            exit 0
            ;;
        esac
    }
    done
}

is_double_click()
{
    if [ $(cat $LAST_HOLD_TIME) -lt 1 -a $(cat $CUR_HOLD_TIME) -lt 1 -a $(cat $INTERVAL_TIME) -eq 0 ]
    then
        return 1
    fi
    return 0
}

one_click_check()
{
    release_time=`date +%s`
    while [ true ]
    do
        cur_time=`date +%s`
        # if INTERVAL_TIME is 0, means double click
        if [ $(cat $INTERVAL_TIME) -eq 0 -o $(cat $BTN_ACTION) = "pressed" ];then exit 0; fi

        # if no press action after release 1s, means one click
        interval_time=`expr $cur_time - $release_time`
        if [ $(cat $INTERVAL_TIME) -gt 0 -a $interval_time -gt 1 ];then
            if [ "X$opid" = "X0000" ]; then
                echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: Reset button pressed" |tee -a /logs/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
            else
                echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: REBOOT due to reset button click" |tee -a /logs/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
                reboot
            fi
            exit 0
        fi
    done
}

deep_fac_reset()
{
    echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: Deep factory default reset due to reset button double click" |tee -a /logs/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
    /usr/sbin/ledtool allblink
    /usr/exe/factory-default-reset all
}

case "${ACTION}" in
    "pressed")
        [ -e $CUR_HOLD_TIME ] && cat $CUR_HOLD_TIME > $LAST_HOLD_TIME
        echo $SEEN > $INTERVAL_TIME
        echo "${ACTION}" > $BTN_ACTION
        led_ctrl &
    ;;
    "released")
        echo "${ACTION}" > $BTN_ACTION
        echo $SEEN > $CUR_HOLD_TIME

        is_double_click
        if [ $? -eq 1 ];then deep_fac_reset; exit 0; fi

        if [ $(cat $CUR_HOLD_TIME) -ge $PRESS_HOLD_TIME ]; then
            if [ ! -f "$RESET_FILE" ]; then
                touch $RESET_FILE
                echo "LocalFactoryReset" > $RESET_FILE
            fi
            echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: FACTORY RESET due to reset button click more than 10s" |tee -a /logs/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
            cfgcli backupkeyparam
			/usr/exe/factory-default-reset
        elif [ $(cat $CUR_HOLD_TIME) -lt 1 ];then
            one_click_check &
        else
            reboot
        fi
    ;;
esac

#!/bin/sh

. /usr/exe/varset.sh

BARDEFAULT=15000
default_logs2tmp()
{
	if [ ! -e /logs/${LOGDEFAULT} ]; then
		return
	fi
	SIZDEFAULT=$(ls -l /logs/${LOGDEFAULT} 2>/dev/null | sed "s/[!\t][ \t]*/ /g" | cut -d" " -f5)
	if [ "0${SIZDEFAULT}" -ge ${BARDEFAULT} ]; then
		mv -f /logs/${LOGDEFAULT} /logs/${BAKDEFAULT}
	else
		cat /logs/${LOGDEFAULT} /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} > /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT}.tmp
		mv -f /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT}.tmp /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT}
	fi
	if [ -f /logs/${BAKDEFAULT} ]; then
		mv -f /logs/${BAKDEFAULT} /tmp/${BAKDEFAULT}
	fi
}

default_tmp2logs()
{
	if [ -f /tmp/${BAKDEFAULT} ]; then mv -f /tmp/${BAKDEFAULT} /logs/${BAKDEFAULT}; fi
	if [ -f /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} ]; then mv -f /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} /logs/${LOGDEFAULT}; fi
}

format_partition()
{
	ubi_part=$1
	echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: format partition $ubi_part ..." | tee -a /logs/$LOGDEFAULT &>/dev/console

	ubi_part_id=$(cat /proc/mtd |grep "\<${ubi_part}\>"|head -n 1 |cut -d: -f1 |cut -c4-)
	ubi_port=$(mount |grep /dev/ubi$ubi_part_id |cut -d' ' -f3)
	echo "CMD: umount ${ubi_port}"
	umount -l ${ubi_port} &>/dev/null
	if [ $? != 0 ];then
		echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: format_partition unmount UBI failed" >> /logs/$LOGDEFAULT
	fi
	echo "CMD: $UBIDETACH $UBIDEVCTL -m ${ubi_part_id}"
	$UBIDETACH $UBIDEVCTL -m ${ubi_part_id} &>/dev/null
	if [ $? != 0 ];then
		echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: format_partition ubidetach mtd and ubi failed" >> /logs/$LOGDEFAULT
	fi
	echo "CMD: $UBIFORMAT /dev/mtd${ubi_part_id} -y"
	$UBIFORMAT /dev/mtd${ubi_part_id} -y &>/dev/null
	if [ $? != 0 ];then
		echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: format_partition format mtd failed" >> /logs/$LOGDEFAULT
	fi
	echo "CMD: $UBIATTACH $UBIDEVCTL -m ${ubi_part_id} -d ${ubi_part_id}"
	ubi_part_info=$($UBIATTACH $UBIDEVCTL -m ${ubi_part_id} -d ${ubi_part_id} 2>/dev/null)
	ubi_part_lebs=$(echo "${ubi_part_info}" |sed "s/^.*\(total\)\(.*\)\(LEBs\).*\(available\).*/\2/" |sed "s/[ \t\n]//g")
	ubi_part_aleb=$(echo "${ubi_part_info}" |sed "s/^.*\(available\)\(.*\)\(LEBs\).*/\2/" |sed "s/[ \t\n]//g")
	ubi_lebs_size=$(echo "${ubi_part_info}" |sed "s/^.*\(LEB size\).*\(bytes (\)\(.*\)\( KiB\).*/\3/" |sed "s/[ \t\n]//g" |cut -d. -f1)
	echo "MSG: ${ubi_part_info}"
	echo "MSG: ubi_part=${ubi_part} ubi_part_lebs=${ubi_part_lebs} ubi_part_aleb=${ubi_part_aleb}"
	## Volume Size = Total - Total/32(Reserved for BEB) - 4(Reserved for Volume)
	## ubi_part_aleb=$((${ubi_part_aleb} - 4)) ## Reserved only for more tolerance
	ubi_vols_lebs=$((${ubi_part_lebs} * 31 / 32 - 4))
	if [ ${ubi_part_aleb} -lt ${ubi_vols_lebs} ]; then ubi_vols_lebs=${ubi_part_aleb}; fi
	ubi_vols_size=$((${ubi_vols_lebs} * ${ubi_lebs_size}))
	echo "MSG: ubi_part=${ubi_part} ubi_vols_lebs=${ubi_vols_lebs} ubi_lebs_size=${ubi_lebs_size} ubi_vols_size=${ubi_vols_size}"
	mdev -s &>/dev/null

	## try to make volume for the ${ubi_part}
	echo "CMD: $UBIMKVOL /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id} -t dynamic -n 0 -N ${ubi_part} -s ${ubi_vols_size}KiB"
	$UBIMKVOL /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id} -t dynamic -n 0 -N ${ubi_part} -s ${ubi_vols_size}KiB &>/dev/null
	if [ $? != 0 ];then
		echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: format_partition ubimkvol ubi failed and reboot the setup" >> /logs/$LOGDEFAULT
		reboot
	fi
	mdev -s &>/dev/null

	## try to mount the ${ubi_part}
	echo "CMD: mount -t ubifs /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id}_0 ${ubi_port}"
	mount -t ubifs /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id}_0 ${ubi_port} &>/dev/null
	if [ $? != 0 ];then
		echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: format_partition mount UBI failed" >> /logs/$LOGDEFAULT
	fi

	echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: format partition $ubi_part done" | tee -a /logs/$LOGDEFAULT &>/dev/console
}

clear_directory()
{
	echo "remove all files in $1" > /dev/console
	find $1 -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 | xargs rm -rf
	if [ $? != 0 ];then
		echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: clear_directory delete the $1 files failed" >> /logs/$LOGDEFAULT
	fi

factory_back_default()
{
	default_logs2tmp
    cfg_partition=`/usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n cfg_partition`
	UBIDIR_CFGLOG_LIST="$cfg_partition:configs log:logs"
	UBIDIR_CFGOPT_LIST="$cfg_partition:configs log:logs user_data:opt"
	loop=0; while [ $loop -le 9 ]
	do
		RESET_FLAG=`/usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n factory_reset_flag`
		if [ ! -z "${RESET_FLAG}" ]; then break; fi
		echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]ERR: get factory_reset_flag but failed $loop times ..." |tee -a /tmp/$LOGDEFAULT &>/dev/console
		sync; mdev -s &>/dev/null
		loop=$(( $loop + 1 ))
	done
	if [ -z "${RESET_FLAG}" -a $loop -ge 9 ]; then
		RESET_FLAG=0
		echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]ERR: get factory_reset_flag timeout, assigned as 0" |tee -a /tmp/$LOGDEFAULT &>/dev/console
	fi
	echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: RESET flag $RESET_FLAG" |tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
	if [ $RESET_FLAG -eq 1 ]; then
		echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: factory default reset ..." |tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
		for list in $UBIDIR_CFGLOG_LIST; do
			dir=$(echo $list |cut -d: -f 2)
			backup_DeepWhiteList $dir
			backup_NormalWhiteList $dir
			echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: Factory reset clear $dir ..." |tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
			rm -rf /$dir/*
			restore_DeepWhiteList $dir
			restore_NormalWhiteList $dir
		done
		remove_ExtraBlackList
		echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: factory default reset completed!" |tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
	elif [ $RESET_FLAG -eq 2 ]; then
		echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: deep factory default reset ..." |tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
		for list in $UBIDIR_CFGOPT_LIST; do
			dir=$(echo $list | cut -d: -f 2)
			mtd=$(echo $list | cut -d: -f 1)
			backup_DeepWhiteList $dir
			clear_directory $dir
			format_partition $mtd
			restore_DeepWhiteList $dir
		done
		echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: deep factory default reset completed!" |tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
	fi
	loop=0; while [ $loop -lt 9 ]
	do
		/usr/sbin/fw_setenv factory_reset_flag 0
		sync; loop=$(( $loop + 1 ))
		if [ "X"`/usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n factory_reset_flag` = "X0" ]; then break; fi
		echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]ERR: factory-default set flag to 0 but failed $loop times ..." |tee -a /tmp/$LOGDEFAULT &>/dev/console
	done
	default_tmp2logs
}

uenv_get()
{
    key=$1
    cmd="/usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n $key"
    loop=0; while [ $loop -le 9 ]; do
        value=$($cmd)
        echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: $0 - $cmd = $value @ $loop" |tee -a $SYSLOGS &>/dev/console
        if [ ! -z "$value" ]; then echo $value; return 0; fi
        loop=$(( $loop + 1 ))
    done
    echo 0; return 1
}

uenv_set()
{
    key=$1
    value=$2
    cmd="/usr/sbin/fw_setenv $key $value"
    loop=0; while [ $loop -le 9 ]; do
        $cmd; sync
	retVal=$(/usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n $key)
        echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: $0 - $cmd = $retVal @ $loop" |tee -a $SYSLOGS &>/dev/console
        if [ "X$value" = "X$retVal" ]; then return 0; fi
        loop=$(( $loop + 1 ))
    done
    return 1
}

# 1 means upgrade, 0 means no upgrade
is_upgrade()
{
    sb_num=$(/usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n sb_flag)
    let "sb_data=sb_num & 0x88"

    if [ $sb_data -eq 128 -o $sb_data -eq 8 ];then
        echo "1"
    else
        echo "0"
    fi
}

            echo "MSG: mount /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id}_${ubi_seed} ${ubi_port} with code=${ubi_err}" &>/dev/null

            ## check the mount ${ubi_port} size
            ubi_size=$(df -k |grep "\<ubi${ubi_part_id}_[012]\>" |sed "s/ [ \t]*/:/g"|cut -d: -f2)
            echo "MSG: ${ubi_port} size is ${ubi_size}KB" &>/dev/console
            if [ "0${ubi_size}" -lt 768 ]; then ubi_err=$((${ubi_err} + 1)); fi

            ## try to touch/write the mounted folder ${ubi_port}
            [ $ubi_err -eq 0 ] && touch ${ubi_port}/${TAGUBIFSWR}
            ubi_err=$((${ubi_err} + $?))
            echo "MSG: touch ${ubi_port}/${TAGUBIFSWR} with code=${ubi_err}" &>/dev/null

            ## check whether here is any error to try to recover
            if [ ${ubi_err} != 0 ]; then
                ## set fail flag to check if need to recover data
                uenv_set mount_$(echo $ubi_port | cut -d'/' -f 2)_fail 1
                echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: Partition ${ubi_part} damaged! Try to recover ..." |tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
                echo "CMD: umount ${ubi_port}"
                umount -l ${ubi_port} &>/dev/null
                echo "CMD: $UBIDETACH $UBIDEVCTL -m ${ubi_part_id}"
                $UBIDETACH $UBIDEVCTL -m ${ubi_part_id} &>/dev/null
                echo "CMD: $UBIFORMAT /dev/mtd${ubi_part_id} -y"
                $UBIFORMAT /dev/mtd${ubi_part_id} -y &>/dev/null
                echo "CMD: $UBIATTACH $UBIDEVCTL -m ${ubi_part_id} -d ${ubi_part_id}"
                ubi_part_info=$($UBIATTACH $UBIDEVCTL -m ${ubi_part_id} -d ${ubi_part_id} 2>/dev/null)
                ubi_part_lebs=$(echo "${ubi_part_info}" |sed "s/^.*\(total\)\(.*\)\(LEBs\).*\(available\).*/\2/" |sed "s/[ \t\n]//g")
                ubi_part_aleb=$(echo "${ubi_part_info}" |sed "s/^.*\(available\)\(.*\)\(LEBs\).*/\2/" |sed "s/[ \t\n]//g")
                ubi_lebs_size=$(echo "${ubi_part_info}" |sed "s/^.*\(LEB size\).*\(bytes (\)\(.*\)\( KiB\).*/\3/" |sed "s/[ \t\n]//g" |cut -d. -f1)
                echo "MSG: ${ubi_part_info}"
                echo "MSG: ubi_part=${ubi_part} ubi_part_lebs=${ubi_part_lebs} ubi_part_aleb=${ubi_part_aleb}"
                ## Volume Size = Total - Total/32(Reserved for BEB) - 4(Reserved for Volume)
                ## ubi_part_aleb=$((${ubi_part_aleb} - 4)) ## Reserved only for more tolerance
                ubi_vols_lebs=$((${ubi_part_lebs} * 31 / 32 - 4))
                if [ ${ubi_part_aleb} -lt ${ubi_vols_lebs} ]; then ubi_vols_lebs=${ubi_part_aleb}; fi
                ubi_vols_size=$((${ubi_vols_lebs} * ${ubi_lebs_size}))
                echo "MSG: ubi_part=${ubi_part} ubi_vols_lebs=${ubi_vols_lebs} ubi_lebs_size=${ubi_lebs_size} ubi_vols_size=${ubi_vols_size}"
                mdev -s &>/dev/null

                ## try to make volume for the ${ubi_part}
                echo "CMD: $UBIMKVOL /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id} -t dynamic -n 0 -N ${ubi_part} -s ${ubi_vols_size}KiB"
                $UBIMKVOL /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id} -t dynamic -n 0 -N ${ubi_part} -s ${ubi_vols_size}KiB &>/dev/null
                if [ $? != 0 ]; then reboot; fi    #reboot and try again
                mdev -s &>/dev/null

                ## try to mount the ${ubi_part}
                echo "CMD: mount -t ubifs /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id}_0 ${ubi_port}"
                mount -t ubifs /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id}_0 ${ubi_port} &>/dev/null
            fi
            echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: mount $ubi_port completed" | tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
    fi
}

check_abnormal_reboot()
{
	reboot_data=$(devmem 0xf4320114)
	let "panic=(reboot_data>>16) & 0x01"
	let "kernel=(reboot_data>>18) & 0x01"
	let "app=(reboot_data>>19) & 0x01"
	let "watchdog=(reboot_data>>20) & 0x01"

	sb_para=$(usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n sb_flag)
	let "sb0_data=sb_para & 0x09"
	let "sb1_data=(sb_para>>4) & 0x09"

	echo "check_abnormal_reboot start" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
	echo "data_panic:${panic} data_kernel:${kernel} data_app:${app} data_wdt:${watchdog} sb_flag:${sb_para} " |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console

	if [ "X$panic" == "X1" ]||[ "X$watchdog" == "X1" ]||[ "X$kernel" == "X1" ]&&[ "X$app" == "X0" ];then
		echo "ont started abnormally last time" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
		if [ [ "Xsb0_data" == "X9" ] || [ "Xsb1_data" == "X9" ] ];then
			echo "rollback to the backup partition" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
			backupversion="null"
			/usr/sbin/fw_setenv img_version$standby $backupversion &>/dev/null

			sb_num=$(/usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n sb_flag)
			if [ $current -eq 0 ]; then
				let "sb_data=sb_num & 0xDF"
			else
				let "sb_data=sb_num & 0xFD"
			fi
			/usr/sbin/fw_setenv sb_flag $sb_data &>/dev/null
		fi
	fi

	sb_info=$(usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n sb_flag)
	backup_version=$(usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n img_version$standby)
	echo "after: sb_info:${sb_info} backup_ver:${backup_version}" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
	echo "check_abnormal_reboot end" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
}

dynamic_backup_files()
{
	dynamic_backup_list=$(/usr/exe/json_paser DataGuardianParams.DynamicBackupFileList < /etc/HB_Config.json)
	# backup files for every one day
	while [ true ]
	do
		sleep 86400
		for file in $dynamic_backup_list; do
			file_dir=$(dirname $file)
			[ ! -e $BACKDIR/$file_dir ] && mkdir -p $BACKDIR/$file_dir
			cp -rf $file $BACKDIR/$file_dir
		done
		sync
	done
}

static_backup_files()
{
	sleep 120  # wait files ready
	static_backup_list=$(/usr/exe/json_paser DataGuardianParams.StaticBackupFileList < /etc/HB_Config.json)
	for file in $static_backup_list; do
		file_dir=$(dirname $file)
		[ ! -e $BACKDIR/$file_dir ] && mkdir -p $BACKDIR/$file_dir
		cp -rf $file $BACKDIR/$file_dir
	done
	sync
}

backup_files_restore()
{
	for file_root_dir in $(ls -l $BACKDIR | awk '{print $9}'); do
		need_restore=$(/usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n mount_${file_root_dir}_fail)
		if [ $need_restore -eq 1 ]; then
			cp -rf $BACKDIR/$file_root_dir/* $file_root_dir/
			sync
			/usr/sbin/fw_setenv mount_${file_root_dir}_fail 0
			/usr/sbin/fw_setenv mount_$(basename $(dirname $BACKDIR))_fail 0
		fi
	done
}

data_guardian()
{
	backup_files_restore
	static_backup_files &
	dynamic_backup_files &
}

backup_log()
{
    BOARDTYPES=`ritool get Mnemonic | awk -F: '{print $2}'`
    echo "the board is $BOARDTYPES, will backup files in tmp to logs" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console

    # unit is KB
    logs_reserve_space=1024

    logs_available_space=$(df -k | grep logs | sed 's/[[:space:]][[:space:]]*/ /g' | cut -d " " -f4)
    if [ $logs_reserve_space -ge $logs_available_space ]; then
        echo "logs available space ${logs_available_space}KB less than reserved ${logs_reserve_space}KB, \
    do not backup files in tmp to logs!" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
    else
        mkdir -p /tmp/reboot
        mkdir -p /logs/history
        log_backup_list=$(/usr/exe/json_paser DataGuardianParams.LogBackupFileList < /etc/HB_Config.json)
        for file in $log_backup_list ;do
            if [ -e $file ]; then
                cp $file /tmp/reboot/ -af
            fi
        done
        cd /tmp/ && tar -zcvf reboot.tar.gz reboot
        cp /tmp/reboot.tar.gz /logs/history/ -af
        echo "$BOARDTYPES : backup files in tmp to logs" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
    fi
}

################### Start of a rule block #############################
# Index of the rule
#RULE = GROUPNAME_RULENAME
RULE = service_system_init
# Condition to start rule, existence of one of the following
#
# NONE - No start condition, application is spawn immediately
# FILE filename - The existence of a file
# RULE_COMPLETED id - Rule id completed successfully
# NETDEVICE netdev - The existence of a networking device
# IPC_OWNER owner - The existence of an IPC destination point
# ENV_VAR name, value - Value of a variable
#
#START_COND = { NONE; FILE filename; PNAME pname; RULE_COMPLETED id; NETDEVICE netdev; IPC_OWNER owner, STATUS script, status }
START_COND = NONE
# Command with parameters, NONE for sync point
#COMMAND = cmd parameters...
COMMAND = /bin/sh /usr/bin/system_init.sh
# Scheduling (priority) of the process
#SCHED = { NICE value; FIFO value }
SCHED = NICE 0
# Daemon flag Process must not end
#DAEMON = { YES, NO }
DAEMON = NO
# Condition to end rule and move to next rule, wait for one of the following:
#
# NONE - No monitor on the result, just spawn application and continue.
# FILE filename - The existence of a file
# EXIT status - The application exited with status. Other statuses are considered failure
# NETDEVICE netdev - The existence of a networking device
# IPC_OWNER owner - The existence of an IPC destination point
# PROCESS_READY The process sent a READY event though PCD API.

    echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: ubi_part=${ubi_part} ubi_port=${ubi_port}" |tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
    if grep -q "\<${ubi_part}\>" /proc/mtd; then
        echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: mount $ubi_port start ..." | tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/null
        ubi_part_id=$(cat /proc/mtd |grep "\<${ubi_part}\>"|head -n 1 |cut -d: -f1 |cut -c4-)
        echo "CMD: $UBIATTACH $UBIDEVCTL -m ${ubi_part_id} -d ${ubi_part_id}" &>/dev/console
        $UBIATTACH $UBIDEVCTL -m ${ubi_part_id} -d ${ubi_part_id} &>/dev/null
        mdev -s &>/dev/null

            ## try to mount the ${ubi_part} to the ${ubi_port}
            echo "CMD: mount -t ubifs /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id}_${ubi_seed} ${ubi_port}" &>/dev/console
            mount -t ubifs /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id}_${ubi_seed} ${ubi_port} &>/dev/null
            ubi_err=$?
            echo "MSG: mount /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id}_${ubi_seed} ${ubi_port} with code=${ubi_err}" &>/dev/null

            ## check the mount ${ubi_port} size
            ubi_size=$(df -k |grep "\<ubi${ubi_part_id}_[012]\>" |sed "s/ [ \t]*/:/g"|cut -d: -f2)
            echo "MSG: ${ubi_port} size is ${ubi_size}KB" &>/dev/console
            if [ "0${ubi_size}" -lt 768 ]; then ubi_err=$((${ubi_err} + 1)); fi

            ## try to touch/write the mounted folder ${ubi_port}
            [ $ubi_err -eq 0 ] && touch ${ubi_port}/${TAGUBIFSWR}
            ubi_err=$((${ubi_err} + $?))
            echo "MSG: touch ${ubi_port}/${TAGUBIFSWR} with code=${ubi_err}" &>/dev/null

            ## check whether here is any error to try to recover
            if [ ${ubi_err} != 0 ]; then
                ## set fail flag to check if need to recover data
                uenv_set mount_$(echo $ubi_port | cut -d'/' -f 2)_fail 1
                echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: Partition ${ubi_part} damaged! Try to recover ..." |tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
                echo "CMD: umount ${ubi_port}"
                umount -l ${ubi_port} &>/dev/null
                echo "CMD: $UBIDETACH $UBIDEVCTL -m ${ubi_part_id}"
                $UBIDETACH $UBIDEVCTL -m ${ubi_part_id} &>/dev/null
                echo "CMD: $UBIFORMAT /dev/mtd${ubi_part_id} -y"
                $UBIFORMAT /dev/mtd${ubi_part_id} -y &>/dev/null
                echo "CMD: $UBIATTACH $UBIDEVCTL -m ${ubi_part_id} -d ${ubi_part_id}"
                ubi_part_info=$($UBIATTACH $UBIDEVCTL -m ${ubi_part_id} -d ${ubi_part_id} 2>/dev/null)
                ubi_part_lebs=$(echo "${ubi_part_info}" |sed "s/^.*\(total\)\(.*\)\(LEBs\).*\(available\).*/\2/" |sed "s/[ \t\n]//g")
                ubi_part_aleb=$(echo "${ubi_part_info}" |sed "s/^.*\(available\)\(.*\)\(LEBs\).*/\2/" |sed "s/[ \t\n]//g")
                ubi_lebs_size=$(echo "${ubi_part_info}" |sed "s/^.*\(LEB size\).*\(bytes (\)\(.*\)\( KiB\).*/\3/" |sed "s/[ \t\n]//g" |cut -d. -f1)
                echo "MSG: ${ubi_part_info}"
                echo "MSG: ubi_part=${ubi_part} ubi_part_lebs=${ubi_part_lebs} ubi_part_aleb=${ubi_part_aleb}"
                ## Volume Size = Total - Total/32(Reserved for BEB) - 4(Reserved for Volume)
                ## ubi_part_aleb=$((${ubi_part_aleb} - 4)) ## Reserved only for more tolerance
                ubi_vols_lebs=$((${ubi_part_lebs} * 31 / 32 - 4))
                if [ ${ubi_part_aleb} -lt ${ubi_vols_lebs} ]; then ubi_vols_lebs=${ubi_part_aleb}; fi
                ubi_vols_size=$((${ubi_vols_lebs} * ${ubi_lebs_size}))
                echo "MSG: ubi_part=${ubi_part} ubi_vols_lebs=${ubi_vols_lebs} ubi_lebs_size=${ubi_lebs_size} ubi_vols_size=${ubi_vols_size}"
                mdev -s &>/dev/null

                ## try to make volume for the ${ubi_part}
                echo "CMD: $UBIMKVOL /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id} -t dynamic -n 0 -N ${ubi_part} -s ${ubi_vols_size}KiB"
                $UBIMKVOL /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id} -t dynamic -n 0 -N ${ubi_part} -s ${ubi_vols_size}KiB &>/dev/null
                if [ $? != 0 ]; then reboot; fi    #reboot and try again
                mdev -s &>/dev/null

                ## try to mount the ${ubi_part}
                echo "CMD: mount -t ubifs /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id}_0 ${ubi_port}"
                mount -t ubifs /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id}_0 ${ubi_port} &>/dev/null
            fi
            echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: mount $ubi_port completed" | tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
    fi
}

check_abnormal_reboot()
{
	reboot_data=$(devmem 0xf4320114)
	let "panic=(reboot_data>>16) & 0x01"
	let "kernel=(reboot_data>>18) & 0x01"
	let "app=(reboot_data>>19) & 0x01"
	let "watchdog=(reboot_data>>20) & 0x01"

	sb_para=$(usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n sb_flag)
	let "sb0_data=sb_para & 0x09"
	let "sb1_data=(sb_para>>4) & 0x09"

	echo "check_abnormal_reboot start" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
	echo "data_panic:${panic} data_kernel:${kernel} data_app:${app} data_wdt:${watchdog} sb_flag:${sb_para} " |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console

	if [ "X$panic" == "X1" ]||[ "X$watchdog" == "X1" ]||[ "X$kernel" == "X1" ]&&[ "X$app" == "X0" ];then
		echo "ont started abnormally last time" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
		if [ [ "Xsb0_data" == "X9" ] || [ "Xsb1_data" == "X9" ] ];then
			echo "rollback to the backup partition" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
			backupversion="null"
			/usr/sbin/fw_setenv img_version$standby $backupversion &>/dev/null

			sb_num=$(/usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n sb_flag)
			if [ $current -eq 0 ]; then
				let "sb_data=sb_num & 0xDF"
			else
				let "sb_data=sb_num & 0xFD"
			fi
			/usr/sbin/fw_setenv sb_flag $sb_data &>/dev/null
		fi
	fi

	sb_info=$(usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n sb_flag)
	backup_version=$(usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n img_version$standby)
	echo "after: sb_info:${sb_info} backup_ver:${backup_version}" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
	echo "check_abnormal_reboot end" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
}

    tar -xzf /tmp/sysupgrade.tgz -C /tmp/rootfs_data

 }

#!/bin/sh

dynamic_backup_files()
{
	dynamic_backup_list=$(/usr/exe/json_paser DataGuardianParams.DynamicBackupFileList < /etc/HB_Config.json)
	# backup files for every one day
	while [ true ]
	do
		sleep 86400
		for file in $dynamic_backup_list; do
			file_dir=$(dirname $file)
			[ ! -e $BACKDIR/$file_dir ] && mkdir -p $BACKDIR/$file_dir
			cp -rf $file $BACKDIR/$file_dir
		done
		sync
	done
}

static_backup_files()
{
	sleep 120  # wait files ready
	static_backup_list=$(/usr/exe/json_paser DataGuardianParams.StaticBackupFileList < /etc/HB_Config.json)
	for file in $static_backup_list; do
		file_dir=$(dirname $file)
		[ ! -e $BACKDIR/$file_dir ] && mkdir -p $BACKDIR/$file_dir
		cp -rf $file $BACKDIR/$file_dir
	done
	sync
}

backup_files_restore()
{
	for file_root_dir in $(ls -l $BACKDIR | awk '{print $9}'); do
		need_restore=$(/usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n mount_${file_root_dir}_fail)
		if [ $need_restore -eq 1 ]; then
			cp -rf $BACKDIR/$file_root_dir/* $file_root_dir/
			sync
			/usr/sbin/fw_setenv mount_${file_root_dir}_fail 0
			/usr/sbin/fw_setenv mount_$(basename $(dirname $BACKDIR))_fail 0
		fi
	done
}

data_guardian()
{
	backup_files_restore
	static_backup_files &
	dynamic_backup_files &
}

backup_log()
{
    BOARDTYPES=`ritool get Mnemonic | awk -F: '{print $2}'`
    echo "the board is $BOARDTYPES, will backup files in tmp to logs" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console

    # unit is KB
    logs_reserve_space=1024

    logs_available_space=$(df -k | grep logs | sed 's/[[:space:]][[:space:]]*/ /g' | cut -d " " -f4)
    if [ $logs_reserve_space -ge $logs_available_space ]; then
        echo "logs available space ${logs_available_space}KB less than reserved ${logs_reserve_space}KB, \
    do not backup files in tmp to logs!" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
    else
        mkdir -p /tmp/reboot
        mkdir -p /logs/history
        log_backup_list=$(/usr/exe/json_paser DataGuardianParams.LogBackupFileList < /etc/HB_Config.json)
        for file in $log_backup_list ;do
            if [ -e $file ]; then
                cp $file /tmp/reboot/ -af
            fi
        done
        cd /tmp/ && tar -zcvf reboot.tar.gz reboot
        cp /tmp/reboot.tar.gz /logs/history/ -af
        echo "$BOARDTYPES : backup files in tmp to logs" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
    fi
}

################### Start of a rule block #############################
# Index of the rule
#RULE = GROUPNAME_RULENAME
RULE = service_system_init
# Condition to start rule, existence of one of the following
#
# NONE - No start condition, application is spawn immediately
# FILE filename - The existence of a file
# RULE_COMPLETED id - Rule id completed successfully
# NETDEVICE netdev - The existence of a networking device
# IPC_OWNER owner - The existence of an IPC destination point
# ENV_VAR name, value - Value of a variable
#
#START_COND = { NONE; FILE filename; PNAME pname; RULE_COMPLETED id; NETDEVICE netdev; IPC_OWNER owner, STATUS script, status }
START_COND = NONE
# Command with parameters, NONE for sync point
#COMMAND = cmd parameters...
COMMAND = /bin/sh /usr/bin/system_init.sh
# Scheduling (priority) of the process
#SCHED = { NICE value; FIFO value }
SCHED = NICE 0
# Daemon flag Process must not end
#DAEMON = { YES, NO }
DAEMON = NO
# Condition to end rule and move to next rule, wait for one of the following:
#
# NONE - No monitor on the result, just spawn application and continue.
# FILE filename - The existence of a file
# EXIT status - The application exited with status. Other statuses are considered failure
# NETDEVICE netdev - The existence of a networking device
# IPC_OWNER owner - The existence of an IPC destination point
# PROCESS_READY The process sent a READY event though PCD API.
# WAIT msecs - Delay, ignore END_COND_TIMEOUT
#
#END_COND = { NONE; FILE filename; EXIT status; NETDEVICE netdev; IPC_OWNER owner; WAIT msecs; PROCESS_READY }
END_COND = FILE /tmp/system_inited
# Timeout for end condition. Fail if timeout expires. -1 if not relevant.
#END_COND_TIMEOUT = msecs
END_COND_TIMEOUT = -1
# Action upon failure, do one of the following actions upon failure
# NONE Do not take any action
# REBOOT - Reboot the system
# RESTART - Restart the rule
# EXEC_RULE id - Execute a rule
#
#FAILURE_ACTION = { NONE, REBOOT, RESTART, EXEC_RULE id }
FAILURE_ACTION = NONE
# if RESTART is followed by a number, it will the number of restart allowed in FAILURE_RESET_COUNT hour(s). After this number of fail, the action will be definitively NONE.
# Action upon second failure (only if the first one is RESTART), do one of the following actions upon failure 
# FAILURE_ACTION2 = {NONE | REBOOT | RESTART | EXEC_RULE} 
# Action upon next failures (only if the second one is RESTART), do one of the following actions upon failure 
# FAILURE_ACTION_NEXT = {NONE | REBOOT | RESTART | EXEC_RULE} 
# Interval in seconds between a failure and the next failure action.
# FAILURE_INTERVAL = (0..4294967)
# Time in hours before resetting the failure counter. 0: use only the first failure action.
# FAILURE_RESET_COUNT = (0..1193)

				uenv_set mount_$(echo $ubi_port | cut -d'/' -f 2)_fail 1
				echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: Partition ${ubi_part} damaged! Try to recover ..." |tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
				echo "CMD: umount ${ubi_port}"
				umount -l ${ubi_port} &>/dev/null
				echo "CMD: $UBIDETACH $UBIDEVCTL -m ${ubi_part_id}"
				$UBIDETACH $UBIDEVCTL -m ${ubi_part_id} &>/dev/null
				echo "CMD: $UBIFORMAT /dev/mtd${ubi_part_id} -y"
				$UBIFORMAT /dev/mtd${ubi_part_id} -y &>/dev/null
				echo "CMD: $UBIATTACH $UBIDEVCTL -m ${ubi_part_id} -d ${ubi_part_id}"
				ubi_part_info=$($UBIATTACH $UBIDEVCTL -m ${ubi_part_id} -d ${ubi_part_id} 2>/dev/null)
				ubi_part_lebs=$(echo "${ubi_part_info}" |sed "s/^.*\(total\)\(.*\)\(LEBs\).*\(available\).*/\2/" |sed "s/[ \t\n]//g")
				ubi_part_aleb=$(echo "${ubi_part_info}" |sed "s/^.*\(available\)\(.*\)\(LEBs\).*/\2/" |sed "s/[ \t\n]//g")
				ubi_lebs_size=$(echo "${ubi_part_info}" |sed "s/^.*\(LEB size\).*\(bytes (\)\(.*\)\( KiB\).*/\3/" |sed "s/[ \t\n]//g" |cut -d. -f1)
				echo "MSG: ${ubi_part_info}"
				echo "MSG: ubi_part=${ubi_part} ubi_part_lebs=${ubi_part_lebs} ubi_part_aleb=${ubi_part_aleb}"
				## Volume Size = Total - Total/32(Reserved for BEB) - 4(Reserved for Volume)
				## ubi_part_aleb=$((${ubi_part_aleb} - 4)) ## Reserved only for more tolerance
				ubi_vols_lebs=$((${ubi_part_lebs} * 31 / 32 - 4))
				if [ ${ubi_part_aleb} -lt ${ubi_vols_lebs} ]; then ubi_vols_lebs=${ubi_part_aleb}; fi
				ubi_vols_size=$((${ubi_vols_lebs} * ${ubi_lebs_size}))
				echo "MSG: ubi_part=${ubi_part} ubi_vols_lebs=${ubi_vols_lebs} ubi_lebs_size=${ubi_lebs_size} ubi_vols_size=${ubi_vols_size}"
				mdev -s &>/dev/null

				## try to make volume for the ${ubi_part}
				echo "CMD: $UBIMKVOL /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id} -t dynamic -n 0 -N ${ubi_part} -s ${ubi_vols_size}KiB"
				$UBIMKVOL /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id} -t dynamic -n 0 -N ${ubi_part} -s ${ubi_vols_size}KiB &>/dev/null
				if [ $? != 0 ]; then reboot; fi    #reboot and try again
				mdev -s &>/dev/null

				## try to mount the ${ubi_part}
				echo "CMD: mount -t ubifs /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id}_0 ${ubi_port}"
				mount -t ubifs /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id}_0 ${ubi_port} &>/dev/null
			fi
			echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: mount $ubi_port completed" | tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
		fi
	done
}

_mount_emmc_partition()

	if [ -z "${emmcblock}" ];then

		reboot
	fi
	loopdev="$(losetup -f)"
	losetup $loopdev $emmcblock || {
		echo "Failed to mount looped ${mmc_block_name}."  >/dev/console
		reboot
	}

	echo "Run cmd: mount -t ext4 "$loopdev" ${mmc_mount_point}" > /dev/console
	if [ "X${mmc_mount_option}" != "X" ];then
		echo "Run cmd: mount -o ${mmc_mount_option} -t ext4 "$loopdev" ${mmc_mount_point}" > /dev/console
		mount -o ${mmc_mount_option} -t ext4 "$loopdev" ${mmc_mount_point} > /dev/console 2>&1
	else
		mount -t ext4 "$loopdev" ${mmc_mount_point} > /dev/console 2>&1
	fi

	if [ "$?" -ne "0" ];then
		echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: mount ${mmc_block_name} failed,try format this block and mount once more..." |tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
		echo y | mkfs.ext4 -F -L ${mmc_block_name} $loopdev
		if [ "$?" -ne "0" ];then
			echo "format ${mmc_block_name} failed..." > /dev/console
			reboot
		fi
	    uenv_set mount_$(basename ${mmc_mount_point})_fail 1
		mount -t ext4 "$loopdev" ${mmc_mount_point} >/dev/console 2>&1
		if [ "$?" -ne "0" ];then
			echo "mount ${mmc_block_name} failed again..." >/dev/console
			reboot
		fi
	fi

        current_version=$(cat /etc/buildinfo | grep -w IMAGEVERSION | cut -d'=' -f2)
        /usr/sbin/fw_setenv img_version$current $current_version &>/dev/null

        standby_version=$(/usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n img_version$standby)||standby_version="0"
        tmp_version=$(cat $BACKUPROOTFSINFO | grep -w IMAGEVERSION | cut -d'=' -f2)

	if [ -e /logs/reboot.log ]; then

		if [ $filesize -gt 460800 ]; then

			cd /logs; mv -f reboot.log reboot.bak ; tar zcvf reboot.log.tar.gz  reboot.bak; cd -

			/bin/echo "---- REBOOT REASON COLLECTED BELOW ----" |tee -a /logs/reboot.log &>/dev/console

		[ -d /sys/firmware/devicetree/base/reserved-memory/kmsg_collect@0x55b00000 ] && insmod /lib/modules/*/kmsg.ko

dynamic_backup_files()
{
	dynamic_backup_list=$(/usr/exe/json_paser DataGuardianParams.DynamicBackupFileList < /etc/HB_Config.json)
	# backup files for every one day
	while [ true ]
	do
		sleep 86400
		for file in $dynamic_backup_list; do
			file_dir=$(dirname $file)
			[ ! -e $BACKDIR/$file_dir ] && mkdir -p $BACKDIR/$file_dir
			cp -rf $file $BACKDIR/$file_dir
		done
		sync
	done
}

static_backup_files()
{
	sleep 120  # wait files ready
	static_backup_list=$(/usr/exe/json_paser DataGuardianParams.StaticBackupFileList < /etc/HB_Config.json)
	for file in $static_backup_list; do
		file_dir=$(dirname $file)
		[ ! -e $BACKDIR/$file_dir ] && mkdir -p $BACKDIR/$file_dir
		cp -rf $file $BACKDIR/$file_dir
	done
	sync
}

backup_files_restore()
{
	for file_root_dir in $(ls -l $BACKDIR | awk '{print $9}'); do
		need_restore=$(/usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n mount_${file_root_dir}_fail)
		if [ $need_restore -eq 1 ]; then
			cp -rf $BACKDIR/$file_root_dir/* $file_root_dir/
			sync
			/usr/sbin/fw_setenv mount_${file_root_dir}_fail 0
			/usr/sbin/fw_setenv mount_$(basename $(dirname $BACKDIR))_fail 0
		fi
	done
}

data_guardian()
{
	backup_files_restore
	static_backup_files &
	dynamic_backup_files &
}

mount_adsp_fw (){

	local arch=""

	if mount | grep -q ADSP_FW; then

	nor_part=$(cat /proc/mtd | grep ADSPFW | awk '{print $1}' | sed 's/:$//')
	local nor_flash=`find /sys/bus/spi/devices/*/mtd -name ${nor_part}`
	nand_part=$(find_mtd_part $ubi_part_name 2> /dev/null)
	mkdir -p /lib/firmware/$arch/ADSP_FW

	if [ -n "$emmc_part" ]; then
		/bin/mount -t squashfs $emmc_part /lib/firmware/$arch/ADSP_FW > /dev/console 2>&1

			/bin/mount -t squashfs $nor_mtd_part /lib/firmware/$arch/ADSP_FW > /dev/console 2>&1
		fi

		local PART=$(grep -w  "rootfs" /proc/mtd | awk -F: '{print $1}')

stop_wifi_fw() {
	local emmc_part=""
	local nand_part=""
	local nor_part=""
	local primaryboot=""
	local part_name="0:WIFIFW"
	local wifi_on_rootfs=""
	local nor_flash=""
	arch=$1

	if [[ "$arch" == "IPQ6018" ]] || [[ "$arch" == "IPQ5018" ]]; then
		part_name="rootfs"
		wifi_on_rootfs="1"
	fi

	local age0=$(cat /proc/boot_info/bootconfig0/age)
	local age1=$(cat /proc/boot_info/bootconfig1/age)
	local bootname="bootconfig1"

	#Try mode
	if [ -e /proc/upgrade_info/trybit ]; then
		if [ $age1 -ge $age0 ]; then
			bootname="bootconfig1"
		else
			bootname="bootconfig0"
		fi
	fi

	primaryboot=$(cat /proc/boot_info/$bootname/$part_name/primaryboot)
	if [ $primaryboot -eq 1 ]; then
		part_name="${part_name}_1"
	fi

	emmc_part=$(find_mmc_part $part_name 2> /dev/null)
	nor_part=$(cat /proc/mtd | grep -w "WIFIFW" | awk '{print $1}' | sed 's/:$//')
	if [ -n "$nor_part" ]; then
		nor_flash=`find /sys/bus/spi/devices/*/mtd -name ${nor_part}`
	fi
	nand_part=$(find_mtd_part $part_name 2> /dev/null)
	if [ -n "$emmc_part" ]; then
		umount /lib/firmware/$arch/WIFI_FW
	elif [ -n "$nor_flash" ]; then
		local nor_mtd_part=$(find_mtd_part $part_name 2> /dev/null)
		umount /lib/firmware/$arch/WIFI_FW
	elif [ -n "$nand_part" ]; then
		umount /lib/firmware/$arch/WIFI_FW
		if [ -z "$wifi_on_rootfs" ]; then
			local PART=$(grep -w  "WIFIFW" /proc/mtd | awk -F: '{print $1}')
			ubidetach -f -p  /dev/$PART
			sync
		fi
	fi
}

# Index of the rule
#RULE = GROUPNAME_RULENAME
RULE = service_system_init
# Condition to start rule, existence of one of the following
#
# NONE - No start condition, application is spawn immediately
# FILE filename - The existence of a file
# RULE_COMPLETED id - Rule id completed successfully
# NETDEVICE netdev - The existence of a networking device
# IPC_OWNER owner - The existence of an IPC destination point
# ENV_VAR name, value - Value of a variable
#
#START_COND = { NONE; FILE filename; PNAME pname; RULE_COMPLETED id; NETDEVICE netdev; IPC_OWNER owner, STATUS script, status }
START_COND = NONE
# Command with parameters, NONE for sync point
#COMMAND = cmd parameters...
COMMAND = /bin/sh /usr/bin/system_init.sh
# Scheduling (priority) of the process
#SCHED = { NICE value; FIFO value }
SCHED = NICE 0
# Daemon flag Process must not end
#DAEMON = { YES, NO }
DAEMON = NO
# Condition to end rule and move to next rule, wait for one of the following:
#
# NONE - No monitor on the result, just spawn application and continue.
# FILE filename - The existence of a file
# EXIT status - The application exited with status. Other statuses are considered failure
# NETDEVICE netdev - The existence of a networking device
# IPC_OWNER owner - The existence of an IPC destination point
# PROCESS_READY The process sent a READY event though PCD API.
# WAIT msecs - Delay, ignore END_COND_TIMEOUT
#
#END_COND = { NONE; FILE filename; EXIT status; NETDEVICE netdev; IPC_OWNER owner; WAIT msecs; PROCESS_READY }
END_COND = FILE /tmp/system_inited
# Timeout for end condition. Fail if timeout expires. -1 if not relevant.
#END_COND_TIMEOUT = msecs
END_COND_TIMEOUT = -1
# Action upon failure, do one of the following actions upon failure
# NONE Do not take any action
# REBOOT - Reboot the system
# RESTART - Restart the rule
# EXEC_RULE id - Execute a rule
#
#FAILURE_ACTION = { NONE, REBOOT, RESTART, EXEC_RULE id }
FAILURE_ACTION = NONE
# if RESTART is followed by a number, it will the number of restart allowed in FAILURE_RESET_COUNT hour(s). After this number of fail, the action will be definitively NONE.
# Action upon second failure (only if the first one is RESTART), do one of the following actions upon failure 
# FAILURE_ACTION2 = {NONE | REBOOT | RESTART | EXEC_RULE} 
# Action upon next failures (only if the second one is RESTART), do one of the following actions upon failure 
# FAILURE_ACTION_NEXT = {NONE | REBOOT | RESTART | EXEC_RULE} 
# Interval in seconds between a failure and the next failure action.
# FAILURE_INTERVAL = (0..4294967)
# Time in hours before resetting the failure counter. 0: use only the first failure action.
# FAILURE_RESET_COUNT = (0..1193)
# Rule is Active or not (To be activated later by PCD API)
#ACTIVE = { YES, NO }
ACTIVE = YES
# User id for the process
# USER = { UID | User name }
# ping time out ,Fail if timeout expires.
# ALIVE_TIMEOUT = 10000
################### End of a rule block #############################
